title: Network Rejection Indication
description: Mirrors telux::tel::NetworkRejectInfo, backing IServingSystemListener::onNetworkRejection. Added for Events.json parity (tel_serv.networkRejectionUpdate); pure network-side push with no AP RPC to piggyback on, triggered by force_network_rejection. rat/domain enums reuse the same literal sets as radio.sys_info.ind's rat/domain fields.
